title: BACSAM-II sensible-heat-flux analysis (code and data)

creators.name: Müller, Joshua J.
creators.affiliation: Leipzig Institute for Meteorology (LIM), Leipzig University

description:
Code and data of J. J. Müller, I. Staudinger, F. Gebhardt, D. J. Simon, L. Köhler, J. Hartmann, A. Ehrlich, M. Schäfer, M. D. Shupe and M. Wendisch: Evaluation of reanalysis and satellite products of sensible heat flux over Arctic sea ice against airborne eddy-covariance measurements (submitted to Atmospheric Measurement Techniques).

The archive reproduces every data-derived number, table and figure of the paper from the data it contains: the eddy-covariance sensible heat flux from the 100 Hz measurements of the T-Bird, a sensor package towed below the research aircraft Polar 6 during the BACSAM-II campaign (Svalbard, April 2024); bulk estimates driven by in-situ, MODIS and ERA5 inputs; the model-diagnosed fluxes of ERA5 and CARRA; the sensitivity analysis and the uncertainty budget. With pixi run all, a locked Python environment recomputes them and compares every printed number with the committed reference expected_numbers.txt. README.md describes the procedure, AGENTS.md how to check a statement of the paper against the code, DATA.md the data files.

The code is released under the MIT License. The subsets of third-party products in data/ (ERA5, CARRA, MODIS, the merged MODIS–AMSR2 sea-ice concentration, NASA GIBS imagery) remain under the licences of their providers; see DATA.md.
